svg.title: so that the plaquette is exactly exp z. At z = 0 the residual has the vanishing property (SQ7). Each ordered link derivative lowers the vanishing order by at most one (introduce an extra real variable for the left increment, apply the vanishing composition to the joint variables and differentiate at zero); by induction Jq(A; eU(z)) vanishes to order max(5 −q, 0) in z. For |A| ≤r the directions and the group entries range over a compact set, so on that set times |z| ≤1 the relevant derivatives are bounded and Taylor’s estimate gives (SQ11). For (SQ12) apply (SQ11) to A/θ with |z| ≤c0θ ≤1 and use (SQ9); for q ≥5 use θq ≤θ5.
